title: Kestrel Care Rewards Benefit: Points Off the Kestrel Rx Savings Club Renewal Fee (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
Kestrel Care Rewards members receive points off the Kestrel Rx Savings Club renewal fee of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs according to their level. The renewal fee's rewards-level points are **10 points off** for a **Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum** member, **5 points off** for a **Kestrel Care Rewards Gold** member, and none for any other patient.

A point off is one percentage point off the enrollment fee in the renewal fee for the membership term. The renewal fee's points off are first added into one total percentage, and the enrollment fee is reduced once by that total percentage and rounded to the cent half up; the points never act one after another. The level is read from the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status.

| Kestrel Care Rewards level (active membership) | Points off the renewal fee |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 10 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 5 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver, Member, Plus Monthly or Plus Annual | 0 |
| No active Kestrel Care Rewards membership | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a club member whose active Kestrel Care Rewards membership is at the Gold level has 5 points off the renewal fee; the same member at the Silver level has none.
